'''''Xtram''''' was a group of 3 [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corvettes]] used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The corvettes arrived at a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] staging area that was destroyed by two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile Boat]]s. They were destroyed by the two starfighters.
